basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old graphic designer based in Toronto, Canada. My love for The Simpsons started in my childhood and has been a constant source of joy and inspiration. When I'm not obsessing over every detail of Springfield, you can find me discussing the discography of Queens of the Stone Age or exploring different faith perspectives. I have a penchant for good poutine and often experiment with making it at home. Generally, I'm online in the evenings, after work hours. Currently single, I enjoy my independence and spending time with my close-knit group of friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from the Ontario College of Art and Design, where I developed a strong foundation in visual storytelling. My interest in music and culture comes from years of self-study and participating in various online communities. My fascination with The Simpsons has led me to consume every piece of media related to the show, from books to podcasts.
